Text: A TikTok about {school}'s cafeteria has gone viral. Nobody can agree whether it is praise.
A disgraced Nobel laureate needed somewhere to land and chose {school}.
{school}'s low standards have been rebranded as "radical access" and won a grant.
A scandal at {rival} has sent transfer students fleeing to {school}.
A documentary crew mistook {school} for a scrappy upstart. The {mascot}s are playing along.
An anonymous alum has left {school} a vineyard and a strongly worded letter.
{school}'s servers crashed during a hype cycle, so it is now known as the last human university.
AI Corpone forgot {school} exists, which analysts are calling its best quarter ever.
{school}'s faculty, ignored by every ranking, have quietly done excellent work.
A celebrity influencer enrolled at {school} by accident and has decided to stay.
{school}'s mascot, the {mascot}, has become a meme. Merchandise sales are up 900 percent.
A minor clerical error has listed {school} as "selective." Nobody is correcting it.
{school} has been described as "charming" by a ranking algorithm that confused it with a bed and breakfast.
A rival's chatbot recommended {school} to 10,000 students by mistake.
{school}'s one working printer has become a pilgrimage site.
A retired billionaire, tired of fancy schools, has adopted {school} as a hobby.
The faculty at {school} discovered that nobody is watching and have started teaching whatever they like. Students love it.
{school} was too small to be included in AI Corpone's data breach.
